title: Social Story Frames: Contextual Reasoning about Narrative Intent and Reception
reasoning: The paper introduces a narrative reasoning framework (SSF-TAXONOMY) that explicitly includes a 'Moral' dimension based on Schwartz's theory of basic values. This dimension is used to evaluate and benchmark the ability of Large Language Models (GPT-4o and finetuned Llama 3.1) to infer moral judgments, social values, and traditional beliefs (including religious customs) within social media stories.
